p:create_goal.objective.en: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.
p:create_goal.objective.zh: 从直接的人类请求推断出的具体完成目标。

p:create_goal.max_goal_rounds.en: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.
p:create_goal.max_goal_rounds.zh: 自动续接轮次数的可选上限，须为正安全整数。

p:edit.file_path.en: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.
p:edit.file_path.zh: 待编辑的路径，由文件系统后端解析。在参数中先提供 `file_path`，再提供 `old_string` 和 `new_string`。

p:edit.new_string.en: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.
p:edit.new_string.zh: 替换用的字面文本。用空字符串删除匹配项。

p:edit.replace_all.en: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.
p:edit.replace_all.zh: 替换所有匹配项。默认为 false；为 false 时，old_string 必须恰好出现一次。

p:edit.sandbox_permissions.en: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.
p:edit.sandbox_permissions.zh: 针对沙箱刚刚拒绝的那次操作做一次性重试所用的、最窄的更宽沙箱模式；重试会请求用户审批。

p:edit.justification.en: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.
p:edit.justification.zh: 与 sandbox_permissions 一起使用时必填：用一句话向用户说明为什么这次文件操作需要更宽的访问权限。使用用户当前请求的语言。

p:exit_plan_mode.plan.en: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.
p:exit_plan_mode.plan.zh: 完整的计划，Markdown 格式，以命名该计划的 # 标题开头。

p:glob.pattern.en: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.
p:glob.pattern.zh: 用于匹配文件路径的 glob 模式（如 "**/*.ts"、"src/**/*.test.js"）。不含 "/" 的模式会在任意深度匹配文件名，因此 "*" 和 "*.ts" 都会搜索整棵树；加入分隔符可锚定深度。

p:glob.path.en: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.
p:glob.path.zh: 要搜索的目录。默认为会话工作区；相对路径相对于它解析。

p:grep.pattern.en: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).
p:grep.pattern.zh: 要搜索的正则表达式（ripgrep 语法）。

p:grep.path.en: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.
p:grep.path.zh: 要搜索的文件或目录。默认为会话工作区；相对路径相对于它解析。

p:grep.include.en: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.
p:grep.include.zh: 用于限定搜索哪些文件的单个 glob 过滤器（如 "*.ts"、"*.{js,jsx}"）。不是列表；不支持取反。

p:interrupt_agent.agent_id.en: The id of an agent created under you: your direct child or a deeper descendant.
p:interrupt_agent.agent_id.zh: 在你之下创建的智能体的 id：你的直接子代理或更深层的后代。

p:job_kill.job_id.en: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.
p:job_kill.job_id.zh: 启动该后台任务的工具返回的任务 id。

p:job_kill.reason.en: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.
p:job_kill.reason.zh: 可选的简短原因，会记录到日志并转发给该任务。

p:job_output.wait.en: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.
p:job_output.wait.zh: 阻塞等待，直到任务结束或超时；等待超时后任务仍在运行。默认为 false。

p:job_output.timeout_ms.en: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.
p:job_output.timeout_ms.zh: 在 wait: true 时的最长等待毫秒数。默认值及上限由配置决定。

p:list_agents.scope.en: children (default) lists direct children, which accept send_message in any status. descendants lists the whole tree below you with each entry's parent session id and depth; entries deeper than 1 accept only interrupt_agent.
p:list_agents.scope.zh: children（默认）列出直接子代理，它们在任何状态下都接受 send_message。descendants 列出你之下的整棵树，并给出每个条目的父会话 id 和深度；深度大于 1 的条目只接受 interrupt_agent。

p:pwsh.description.en: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".
p:pwsh.description.zh: 用主动语态清楚简洁地描述该命令做什么，5-10 个词（显示在 UI 中）。示例："ls" → "列出当前目录中的文件"；"git status" → "显示工作树状态"；"Get-Process" → "列出运行中的进程"。

p:pwsh.command.zh: 要执行的 PowerShell 命令。

p:pwsh.timeoutMs.en: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.
p:pwsh.timeoutMs.zh: 超时时间，单位毫秒。执行器会应用其配置的默认值和上限；超时后命令会转入后台成为后台任务，而不是被终止。

p:pwsh.workdir.en: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.
p:pwsh.workdir.zh: 该命令的工作目录。默认为会话工作区；相对路径相对于它解析。

p:pwsh.run_in_background.en: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.
p:pwsh.run_in_background.zh: 在后台运行并立即返回任务 id（用 job_output 收集，用 job_kill 停止）。不适用超时。

p:pwsh.sandbox_permissions.en: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.
p:pwsh.sandbox_permissions.zh: 针对沙箱刚刚拒绝的那条命令做一次性重试所用的、最窄的更宽沙箱模式；重试会请求用户审批。

p:pwsh.justification.en: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.
p:pwsh.justification.zh: 与 sandbox_permissions 一起使用时必填：用一句话向用户说明为什么这条命令需要更宽的访问权限。使用用户当前请求的语言。

p:read.file_path.en: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.
p:read.file_path.zh: 要读取的路径，由文件系统后端解析。

p:read.offset.en: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.
p:read.offset.zh: 要返回的首行，从 1 开始计数。默认为 1。

p:read.limit.en: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.
p:read.limit.zh: 要返回的最大行数。默认为 2000。

p:read_image.file_path.en: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.
p:read_image.file_path.zh: 图像文件的路径，由文件系统后端解析。

p:send_message.agent_id.en: The agent id of your direct continuable child, or your direct parent when you are a resident continuable child.
p:send_message.agent_id.zh: 你的直接可继续子代理的智能体 id；当你是常驻可继续子代理时，则为你的直接父代理。

p:send_message.message.en: The message to deliver to the agent.
p:send_message.message.zh: 要投递给该智能体的消息。

p:skill.name.en: The exact skill name from the available skills list.
p:skill.name.zh: 来自可用技能列表的精确技能名。

p:subagent.cwd.en: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.
p:subagent.cwd.zh: 子代理的初始工作目录。相对路径基于你的当前目录；省略则继承当前目录。此后两个智能体各自的目录变更相互独立。

p:subagent.description.en: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.
p:subagent.description.zh: 对所委派任务的简短描述（3-5 个词），用于显示。

p:subagent.prompt.en: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.
p:subagent.prompt.zh: 交给子代理的完整、自包含任务。它不共享本对话的上下文，因此必须包含它所需的全部信息。

p:subagent_fork.prompt.en: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.
p:subagent_fork.prompt.zh: 交给子代理的任务。它已经能看到本对话中已完成的轮次，因此可以自由地在此基础上展开，只需说明新增的内容。

p:todo_write.todos.en: The COMPLETE task list, replacing any previous list.
p:todo_write.todos.zh: 完整的任务列表，会替换此前的任何列表。

p:todo_write.todos[].content.en: What the task is — a short imperative line.
p:todo_write.todos[].content.zh: 任务是什么——一句简短的祈使句。

p:todo_write.todos[].status.zh: pending（未开始）| in_progress（进行中）| completed（已完成）。

p:update_goal.goal_id.zh: 由 get_goal 返回的精确 id。

p:update_goal.revision.en: Exact positive revision returned by get_goal.
p:update_goal.revision.zh: 由 get_goal 返回的精确修订号，必须为正数。

p:update_goal.action.en: edit, pause, and resume require a direct top-level human request. complete and blocked are also allowed during an automatic continuation of this goal; blocked is rejected before the configured minimum round count.
p:update_goal.action.zh: edit、pause 和 resume 需要来自顶层用户的直接请求。在本目标自动续跑期间也允许 complete 和 blocked；在达到配置的最小轮次数之前，blocked 会被拒绝。

p:update_goal.objective.en: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.
p:update_goal.objective.zh: 替换用的目标；仅在 action 为 edit 时有效。

p:update_goal.max_goal_rounds.en: Replacement cap; valid only with action edit.
p:update_goal.max_goal_rounds.zh: 替换用的上限；仅在 action 为 edit 时有效。

p:update_goal.blocked_reason.en: Required only with action blocked: the concrete condition that persisted across rounds and blocks progress.
p:update_goal.blocked_reason.zh: 仅在 action 为 blocked 时必填：跨多个轮次持续存在、阻碍进展的具体条件。

p:web_search.queries.en: 1–4 search queries; their results are merged.
p:web_search.queries.zh: 1–4 个搜索查询；其结果会被合并。

p:workflow.script.en: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.
p:workflow.script.zh: 纯 JavaScript 函数体，不是 TypeScript，且不含 `export const meta` 语句；允许顶层 await。以 `return <value>` 结尾；该可 JSON 序列化的值即为本工具的结果。

p:workflow.meta.en: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.
p:workflow.meta.zh: 以纯 JSON 表示的工作流标识，不是代码。

p:workflow.meta.name.zh: 简短的工作流名称，采用 kebab-case。

p:workflow.meta.description.en: One-line description of what the workflow does.
p:workflow.meta.description.zh: 一行说明该工作流做什么。

p:workflow.meta.whenToUse.en: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.
p:workflow.meta.whenToUse.zh: 可选：关于何时适用该工作流的指引。

p:workflow.meta.phases.en: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.
p:workflow.meta.phases.zh: 可选的阶段声明，由 phase() 调用匹配。

p:workflow.meta.phases[].title.en: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.
p:workflow.meta.phases[].title.zh: 阶段标题，phase() 调用按精确字符串匹配它。

p:workflow.meta.phases[].detail.en: Optional one-line description of the phase.

p:workflow.meta.phases[].provider.en: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.
p:workflow.meta.phases[].provider.zh: 可选：该阶段预期使用的提供方覆盖项。

p:workflow.meta.phases[].model.en: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.
p:workflow.meta.phases[].model.zh: 可选：该阶段预期使用的模型覆盖项。

p:workflow.args.en: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).
p:workflow.args.zh: 可选的 JSON 输入，以 `args` 全局变量暴露给脚本（裸列表需包成一个字段，例如 {"files": [...]}）。

p:workflow.run_in_background.en: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.
p:workflow.run_in_background.zh: 作为后台任务运行：立即返回任务 id 而不等待；返回值随完成通知一并送达。

p:working_directory.cd.en: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.
p:working_directory.cd.zh: 要进入的已存在目录。省略则读取当前目录。

p:write.file_path.en: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.
p:write.file_path.zh: 要写入的路径，由文件系统后端解析。在参数中先提供 `file_path`，再提供 `content`。

p:write.content.en: Full UTF-8 text content to write.
p:write.content.zh: 要写入的完整 UTF-8 文本内容。

p:ask_user_question.questions.en: Questions to ask the user before continuing.
p:ask_user_question.questions.zh: 在继续之前向用户提出的问题。

p:ask_user_question.questions[].id.en: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.
p:ask_user_question.questions[].id.zh: 该问题的稳定 id；会在回答中原样回传。

p:ask_user_question.questions[].question.en: The specific question to ask the user.
p:ask_user_question.questions[].question.zh: 要向用户提问的具体问题。

p:ask_user_question.questions[].header.en: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".
p:ask_user_question.questions[].header.zh: 可选的简短问题标题，例如 "Confirm" 或 "Choose Mode"。

p:ask_user_question.questions[].options.en: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.
p:ask_user_question.questions[].options.zh: 可选，向用户展示的选项。如果你要推荐其中一项，把它放在第一位，并在该标签后追加 "(Recommended)"。

p:ask_user_question.questions[].options[.zh: 面向用户的简短选项标签。

p:ask_user_question.questions[].options[.en: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.
p:ask_user_question.questions[].options[.zh: 用一句话说明取舍或影响。

p:ask_user_question.questions[].multi_se.en: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.
p:ask_user_question.questions[].multi_se.zh: 用户是否可选中多个选项。默认为 false。

p:create_skill.name.en: Skill name; it will be normalized to kebab-case.
p:create_skill.name.zh: 技能名称；它会被规范化为 kebab-case。

p:create_skill.description.en: A concise routing description for when to use the skill.
p:create_skill.description.zh: 简洁的路由描述，说明何时使用该技能。

p:create_skill.body.en: Markdown instructions that form the skill body.
p:create_skill.body.zh: 构成技能主体的 Markdown 指令。

p:list_mcp_resource_templates.server.zh: 已配置的 MCP 服务器名称。

p:list_mcp_resource_templates.cursor.en: Continuation cursor returned by this server.
p:list_mcp_resource_templates.cursor.zh: 此服务器返回的续页游标。

p:present.files.en: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.
p:present.files.zh: 通常是 1-2 个最重要的交付物；每次调用最多 4 个。

p:present.files[].path.en: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.
p:present.files[].path.zh: 已存在的普通文件的路径。相对路径以会话工作目录为准。

p:schedule_create.prompt.en: Reminder content to present when the target becomes due.
p:schedule_create.prompt.zh: 到点时要呈现的提醒内容。

p:schedule_create.title.en: Concise task name in the user's language, at most 120 characters. Name only the core action and subject; keep essential target identifiers such as PR numbers and branch names. Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.
p:schedule_create.title.zh: 用用户语言写的简洁任务名，最多 120 个字符。只写核心动作与对象；保留 PR 编号、分支名等关键目标标识。不要包含执行频率（如 daily、hourly）、计划日期/时间、时区、任务状态，或配置与执行细节（如 read-only 模式、profile-tag 过滤），即使它们出现在所请求的或现有的标题里。不要追加括号说明。把定时信息放进时间参数，把执行指令放进 prompt。

p:schedule_create.every_seconds.en: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60, aligned to the creation time; changing it with schedule_update re-aligns it to the save time.
p:schedule_create.every_seconds.zh: 固定速率间隔，以整秒为单位，至少 60，按创建时间对齐；用 schedule_update 修改后，将按保存时间重新对齐。

p:schedule_create.daily.en: Every day at a local time.
p:schedule_create.daily.zh: 每天在某个本地时间执行。

p:schedule_create.daily.time.en: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 23:00:00.

p:schedule_create.daily.time_zone.en: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.
p:schedule_create.daily.time_zone.zh: UTC 或 IANA Area/Location，例如 Asia/Shanghai。

p:schedule_create.weekly.en: On the given weekdays at a local time.
p:schedule_create.weekly.zh: 在给定的工作日于某个本地时间执行。

p:schedule_create.weekly.time.en: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 09:00:00.

p:schedule_create.weekly.weekdays.en: ISO weekdays, Monday 1 through Sunday 7, without repetitions.
p:schedule_create.weekly.weekdays.zh: ISO 工作日编号，周一为 1 到周日为 7，不可重复。

p:schedule_create.cron.en: Five-field Vixie cron expression in a time zone.
p:schedule_create.cron.zh: 某个时区下的五字段 Vixie cron 表达式。

p:schedule_create.cron.expression.en: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, for example "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5". When both day fields are restricted, a date matches if either one matches.
p:schedule_create.cron.expression.zh: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week，例如 "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5"。当两个日期字段都受限时，日期只要匹配其中任意一个即算匹配。

p:schedule_create.at.en: Absolute target: an RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a local date, time, and IANA time_zone.
p:schedule_create.at.zh: 绝对目标：带偏移量的 RFC 3339 日期时间，或本地日期、时间加 IANA time_zone。

p:schedule_update.id.zh: 由 schedule_list 返回的定时任务 id。

p:schedule_update.title.en: New task name; follow the schedule_create title rules.
p:schedule_update.title.zh: 新任务名；遵循 schedule_create 的标题规则。
